end.line: Quillon for Sinclair Oduya’s tech transactions group

vo: Sinclair Oduya’s tech transactions group negotiates about three hundred SaaS agreements a year, and clients want redlines overnight.
Quillon redlines the data protection clauses in Word, bringing each one back to the firm’s standard position.
The firm’s positions live in the playbook, learned from signed agreements and approved by a partner.
Ask what a client agreed on sub-processors, and the answer comes back cited to the exact page.
Amara will walk your team through it on Thursday the twenty-sixth.
